source.title: Çatpat Nezaketi Öğreniyor
source.rule: Named runtime characters require book evidence before canonical promotion.

maymun.name: Maymun
maymun.storyEvidence: Builds/plays a branch game with Porsuk, politely invites Çatpat, and appears in the later reflection on a polite response.

porsuk.name: Porsuk
porsuk.storyEvidence: Plays the branch game with Maymun and reacts to Çatpat's rude rejection; appears again in the reflection scene.
identity: long pointed snout with black nose

pitpit.name: Pıtpıt
pitpit.storyEvidence: Carefully selects daisies for their mother; Çatpat rushes through the garden and damages it; later the book states Çatpat could have passed carefully.

market_cashier.name: Market kasiyeri
market_cashier.storyEvidence: Cashier in the market scene where Çatpat's behavior affects the queue.

baykus.name: Baykuş
baykus.reason: not verified as a named runtime character in the reviewed source book

civciv.name: Civciv
civciv.reason: not verified as a named runtime character in the reviewed source book; do not infer identity from the presence of a pink bird
